results.controlIntent: Using [Assignment: organization-defined automated mechanisms]: (a) Document proposed changes to the system; (b) Notify [Assignment: organization-defined approval authorities] of proposed changes to the system; and request change approval; (c) Highlight proposed changes to the system that have not been approved or disapproved within [Assignment: organization-defined time period]; (d) Prohibit changes to the system until designated approvals are received; (e) Document all changes to the system; and (f) Notify [Assignment: organization-defined personnel] when approved changes to the system are completed.

judgment.rationale:
Evidence from two collector tools reveals multiple failures against CM-3(1).r2:

**Requirement (d) — Prohibit changes until designated approvals are received:**
- The `CreateEndpoint` event (57d6220b) occurred at 2025-12-01T11:00:00Z. The registry approval (3ed03699) was granted at 2025-12-01T09:00:00Z. While the deployment timestamp is after the approval timestamp, the CloudTrail note explicitly flags this as a change-control violation, suggesting the deployment was initiated or configured before approval was in place.
- More critically, the `UpdateEndpoint` hotfix event (b72a6d7d, 2026-03-15T14:22:00Z) has **no corresponding registry entry** whatsoever. This is a direct violation of requirement (d): a change was pushed to the production endpoint without any documented approval in the model registry.

**Requirements (a), (b), (c), (e), (f) — Documentation, notification, highlighting, and completion alerts:**
- There is no evidence of automated mechanisms to document proposed changes (a), notify approval authorities (b), highlight unapproved changes within a defined time period (c), document all completed changes (e), or notify personnel when approved changes are completed (f).
- The model registry captures approval for v1 only; the hotfix update has no registry lineage at all, meaning change documentation is incomplete.

**Summary:** At minimum, the hotfix `UpdateEndpoint` event represents an unapproved, undocumented change to the production endpoint — a clear violation of the core prohibition in CM-3(1)(d). Additionally, there is no evidence of the automated notification and documentation mechanisms required by sub-requirements (b), (c), and (f).
gaps: No evidence of automated notification mechanisms to approval authorities (CM-3(1)(b)) — would require inspection of SNS topics, EventBridge rules, or workflow tooling (e.g., Jira, ServiceNow integration).
No evidence of automated highlighting of changes pending approval beyond a defined time period (CM-3(1)(c)).
No evidence of automated completion notifications to designated personnel (CM-3(1)(f)).
The hotfix registry entry is entirely absent — human attestation or a separate change-management system record would be needed to determine whether any out-of-band approval was granted.
The CloudTrail note for CreateEndpoint is ambiguous about whether the deployment was truly pre-approval; a human reviewer should confirm the exact sequence of events around 2025-12-01T09:00–11:00Z.
